exit_policy: Exit 0 only if every required check and final delivery verification passes. Data mismatch is FAIL; missing proof or inaccessible critical evidence is BLOCKED. Neither changes historical exit codes.
reuse_policy: Reuse S native evidence only after S/V ZIP identities, complete native dependency closure, saved stage/instance/cleanup evidence and new independent offline calculations pass. No full-repository hash equality requirement; no unproved executable change allowed.
classification_policy: Every declared reference is critical except exact historical tests/cases/test_* descendants, preclassified before reads. Unreadable noncritical fixtures are UNVERIFIED and full historical coverage is PARTIAL.
preservation_policy: All readable source evidence and frozen K code must retain exact raw bytes. Normalized UTF-8/CRLF-to-LF digests only explain history and never replace preservation.
manifest_policy: Freeze reports and close subprocess logs first. artifact_manifest lists all output files except itself and delivery_verification. delivery_verification hashes artifact_manifest and verifies each member; no recursive self-hash. Work-only mutation fixtures are separately recorded by identity/path/bytes/reason.
